scope: one registered existing N256 smooth shear spatial control versus saved N128, fixed D=.02,T=.05,K4/8
seed_scope: process-local reproducibility for unchanged SciPy exponential norm estimation; no geometry/state/physical-parameter selection
coefficient_state_separation: all12 exact point-defined caches sealed before mass/c0/reference loading
projection: unchanged observe_parent: raw sum fine m*c in original2x2 material groups divided by original parent m; explicit ID and nesting validation
fine_reference_time_adapter: alias original parent_reference_times to reference_times in memory only; no file/member changes
initial_bridges: parent reference initial-minus-c0, projected fine c0-minus-parent c0, projected fine reference initial-minus-projected fine c0; raw vectors retained
parent_solver_projection_factor: sqrt(max raw child_mass_sum/original parent_mass); diagnostic norm factor only, no mass or row normalization
state_indicator: coarse4/8 norm +fine4/8 projected norm +2*(parent reference space+time norms) +fine-reference parent-projection difference norm +saved-versus-recomputed reference-projection difference norm +sum3initial bridge norms +cumulative coarse/fine machine/tail indicators and observed solver differences
coarse_solver_controls: reuse saved N1284/8 machine/tail and primary/control indicators; do not rerun coarse candidate
fine_solver_controls: unchanged1e-16 exact Poisson tail per interval and unchanged machine indicator; whole independent uniformization sequences
H_indicator: absolute coarse4/8 H difference +absolute projected fine4/8 H difference +2*parent reference H space/time differences +reference projection H difference +sum3initial H bridges +observed solver H differences +(2*sqrt(parent total mass)*max(1,max abs parent c0)*absolute solver indicator+absolute solver indicator^2)/parent initial variance
reference_H_time_base: time vector=M127-k128 minus best M127-k256; space vector=M63-k128 minus M127-k128; raw reconstruction only for indicators
normalization: original N128 initial mass fluctuation; native N256 quantities labeled separately
classification: fine better if coarse absolute error-minus-fine absolute error exceeds fixed indicator; fine worse if below negative indicator; otherwise inconclusive, at both nonzero checkpoints separately
stop_if_unresolved_or_adverse: preserve all results; no automatic additional K/N or threshold, state, mass, weight or geometry changes
